reason: A realtime voice interface plugin that captures speech, uses configured cloud ASR and TTS services, and connects spoken interaction with the current DeepSeek Harness session.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供实时语音交互，将浏览器麦克风语音转写为输入，并通过配置的语音服务播报会话回复。
summaries.en: Provides realtime voice interaction for DeepSeek Harness by transcribing browser microphone input and speaking session responses through configured voice services.

capabilities: Captures microphone PCM audio in the browser for realtime speech recognition
Sends audio or speech data to configured external ASR, TTS, OpenAI Realtime, or optional voiceprint services
Streams synthesized speech for local playback
Transcribes speech into the Harness input and can automatically submit eligible drafts
Observes Harness turns and converts selected response text to speech
